requirements.title: PRECISION result satisfies the real-model inquiry relation
requirements.definition: The PRECISION result is related to the real model by INT((p−1)*LOG10(b))+k, where b and p are the RADIX and DIGITS model inquiries for X kind and k is one exactly for a decimal-radix power.

pending.PRECISION-model-inquiry-relation: Compute the right-hand side from RADIX(X), DIGITS(X), and LOG10 using integer interval bounds rather than a rounded literal; assert PRECISION(X) equals that relation for default real and double precision real, and mutate the b or p term.
pending.PRECISION-complex-uses-real-kind-model: Use a complex value whose real kind matches a real companion and assert PRECISION(complex_value) equals PRECISION(real_value); mutate the complex kind.
